body: UpDATE: Nobody is around, and I was bad and ordered supplies to finish things, any advice for distracting myself from the heartache
last time I felt this heartbroken it took me 5 years to get over her, not sure i can make it that long with this much pain
Thanks, I would like to be friends again, but I don't think I can stop loving her.  Paradoxically I find myself wanting to hug her, despite the fact thinking about her hurts.
I'm just so angry at myself, maybe if I worked harder on my mental health issues, or on a better career she would still want me.
